title: Kamay | By Damii.Pixel
description: Texture pack beta for Minecraft Java Edition, a personal texture pack project called KAMAY that I've been wanting to do for a long time. It's still under constant development and changes until it meets my expectations.
body:
Kamay is a texture pack for Minecraft that offers a unique experience thanks to its vibrant and eye-catching colors, without losing the vanilla essence of the base game. Immerse yourself in this new experience with my first texture pack, crafted with passion in every pixel.
The textures of blocks, items, and hostile and peaceful mobs have been redesigned to give the game a fresh look, making players feel like they're in a living, colorful world thanks to their unique shapes.
Available and compatible with all Minecraft versions 1.20 and up.
